# Kaveri Textiles Leave Policy

Effective 1 April 2026. Applies to all permanent employees of Kaveri Textiles Pvt Ltd.

## Earned Leave

Employees accrue 1.5 days of earned leave for every completed month of service, up to 18 days per calendar year.
Unused earned leave can be carried forward, but the balance carried into a new year is capped at 45 days.
Earned leave must be applied for at least 7 days in advance through the HR portal.

## Sick Leave

Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave per year. Sick leave does not carry forward.
A medical certificate from a registered practitioner is required for sick leave longer than 3 consecutive days.

## Maternity and Paternity Leave

Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children, as required by the Maternity Benefit Act.
Paternity leave is 10 working days, to be taken within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption.

## Leave Encashment

On resignation, employees are paid for unused earned leave at their last drawn basic salary.
Sick leave is never encashed.

## Public Holidays

The company observes 12 public holidays per year. The list for each year is published in December. Pongal and Diwali are always included.
